books.title: Guarding the River of Time
books.author: The Raccoon that Plucks Stars (web novel)
books.synopsis: Su Mu is a reservoir keeper with the worst luck in two worlds — until the night his fishing line meets a high-voltage wire and he wakes on a river under two moons. Appointed keeper of a river that remembers everything, he learns that guarding time is the deadliest job in the realm. Adapted from the 610-chapter web novel by The Raccoon that Plucks Stars.
